title: Ombre - Morterone killer
overview: A film crew travels to a remote location to shoot a horror film based on local legends. As production progresses, strange phenomena and fatal accidents begin to blur the line between reality and fiction. Ignoring the warning signs, the director pushes the team beyond their limits, spiraling into a spiral of terror that confuses and consumes everyone. The climax reveals a horror that surpasses all fiction, demonstrating that true fear arises from human obsession.
